I was going through some modelling photos recently sent in, one from an old woman, and the other set from an adolescent boy. I was especially struck by the differences in the cover letters that they wrote: the adolescent boy mentioned growing up kind of an outcast and being made fun of for not being good-looking enough, while the old woman gave the opposite story and talked about always getting compliments on how they look. Who was often found unattractive?
A. The adolescent boy
B. The old woman
C. Cannot answer
